# UniverseIT

> Admissions, academics, exams, fees, finance, HR and operations in one connected system. Entered once, used everywhere, with no exports, no reconciling and no second version of a student's record.

UniverseIT is an ERP for schools, colleges and universities. A SAPTECHS Product.
